text:
Eli Schwartz: Hey team — we have a co-marketing sprint with SkyCloud next month. Need a tight plan for: launch post, a short benchmark narrative, a joint webinar + demo, and inbound lead routing into SFDC. Who owns which piece and can we lock deadlines? Target publish week of May 8. @Maya can you own the launch post? @Tom you on webinar? @Sarah benchmarks & PR? @Anna inbound routing + tracking? I’ll handle partner comms and co-approval. :rocket:

Maya Patel: I can own the post. Will need benchmark stats, one partner quote, and screenshots of the console. Can partner supply a demo account or should we use our sandbox?

Tom Nguyen: Webinar ✅. Propose 45m total: 20m product positioning (us), 15m partner live demo, 10m Q&A. Need slide deck (shared template), runbook, and a rehearsal week prior. Also recommend co-email + partner LinkedIn push. Do we want a hands-on lab or just demo? :thinking_face:

Sarah O'Neill: For the benchmark narrative I’ll focus on three callouts: p95 latency, cost/token delta vs cloud-native baseline, and KV-cache hit rate under sustained load. Plan: run our harness on partner-provided model bundle, document methodology, include reproducible appendix. Aim for a 800–1200 word post + an executive one-pager.

Anna Ruiz: Routing + tracking plan: create unique UTM and SFDC campaign code (utm_source=skycloud_co, campaign=SkyCloud_PartnerLaunch). Leads go to partner_success queue; if email domain matches partner domains then tag and assign to AE queue. I’ll build an automated rule in Marketo + SFDC. Need partner contact list and expected lead volume.

Eli Schwartz: Good — couple of specifics: 1) Landing page + registration form needs to capture "partner_affinity" hidden field. 2) We should use a single campaign in SFDC for attribution and a separate lead source for co-marketing. 3) Can we include a small benchmark snapshot in the post (chart + short blurb) to increase coverage?

Maya Patel: Agree on snapshot. I’ll draft the post and include a 2-chart section: latency CDF and cost per 1k tokens. Will request partner quote and approve with legal for any comparative claims. Draft by Fri EOD and ask for technical review from Sarah.

Tom Nguyen: I'll own the webinar ops: registration form, Zoom webinar set up, rehearsal, follow-up cadence. Suggest CTA flow: register -> attend -> watch recording -> request trial. Need a short demo script and API key for the live demo. Also recommend a co-branded one-pager to hand out in follow-up.

Sarah O'Neill: Test plan for benchmarks: 1) baseline (cloud default) 2) Redwood configured with batching/quantization profile 3) 10k/hr burst test to show stability. I'll push results to the shared drive and attach CSV + command snippet.

Anna Ruiz: Routing snippet (example): ```utm_source=skycloud_co
sf_campaign=SkyCloud_PartnerLaunch
lead_assignment:
  if email_domain in ["@skycloud.com","@skycloud-solutions.com"] -> queue=partner_success, priority=high
  else -> queue=sdr_inbound
tags: ["partner:skycloud","co-marketing"]
```

marketplace-bot: Partner listing checklist: logo(120x60), 300-word description, 2 screenshots, link to landing page, partner contact. Listing goes live once assets are uploaded. :pushpin:

Eli Schwartz: Action items recap — Maya draft by Fri EOD, Sarah bench draft by Thu, Tom build webinar runbook by next Tue, Anna create SFDC campaign + routing rules by Tue. Everyone please confirm with a ✅ and drop any blockers. I’ll sync with SkyCloud PM on Wed and share their approval timeline.

Tom Nguyen: ✅ I’ll schedule rehearsal and request demo account from Eli.

Sarah O'Neill: ✅ will upload benchmark CSVs to the drive and tag the post draft for review.

Maya Patel: ✅ drafting now, will ping for review when ready.

Anna Ruiz: ✅ setting up SFDC campaign; will send routing rule doc and test case this afternoon.

Eli Schwartz: Thanks — if anything changes ping here. I’ll open a shared calendar invite for the cross-team sync. :calendar:
